responsibilities: Partner with business stakeholders to frame business problems, define analytical approaches and translate data into actionable insights that support strategic and operational decision-making.
Analyse large and complex datasets to identify customer, product and commercial trends, uncover opportunities and diagnose business performance.
Develop and maintain scalable analytics solutions, including automated data pipelines, recurring reporting, dashboards and self-service BI capabilities to reduce reliance on manual analysis.
Own analytics end-to-end, from understanding the business question and sourcing and transforming data through analysis, interpretation, recommendations and measurement of outcomes.
Work closely with Product, Customer Lifecycle Management and other business teams to evaluate initiatives, identify growth and retention opportunities and track business outcomes.
Leverage AI and emerging analytics tools, including copilots, AutoML and BI assistants, to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive work and improve speed from data to insight.
Apply appropriate validation and human judgement when using analytical and AI-generated outputs.
Support planning and budgeting processes and prepare materials for regular business reviews, Singtel Singapore and Group top management performance updates and annual planning.
Coordinate planning, preparation and pre-syndication with key stakeholders and follow through on subsequent execution.
Shape responsible adoption of AI analytics tools and support teams in understanding their capabilities and limitations.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Leverage AI and emerging analytics tools, including copilots, AutoML and BI assistants, to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive work and improve speed from data to insight.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Speed language ('accelerate analysis', 'improve speed from data to insight', 'accelerate the journey from data to action') is balanced by validation language ('Apply appropriate validation and human judgement'), so mixed.
evidence.domain_risk: Support planning and budgeting processes and prepare materials for regular business reviews, Singtel Singapore and Group top management performance updates and annual planning.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Telco business analytics feeding management reviews and planning, with no financial-reporting, audit or regulatory language, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Product; Customer Lifecycle Management; Group top management
evidence.data_team_maturity: Develop and maintain scalable analytics solutions, including automated data pipelines, recurring reporting, dashboards and self-service BI capabilities to reduce reliance on manual analysis.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An analytics function exists and is moving from manual analysis to automated, self-service BI ('reduce reliance on manual analysis'), so mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Leverage AI and emerging analytics tools, including copilots, AutoML and BI assistants
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: A few bullets are specific (copilots, AutoML, BI assistants; Customer Lifecycle Management) but most are generic ('Partner with business stakeholders to frame business problems'), so mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: identify customer, product and commercial trends, uncover opportunities and diagnose business performance
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Emphasis is split between product and commercial audiences (growth, retention, revenue) plus management planning, with none dominant, so mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role 'Own[s] analytics end-to-end' and will 'Shape responsible adoption of AI analytics tools' but also supports business teams ('Support planning and budgeting processes'), so mixed.
evidence.ai_role: Leverage AI and emerging analytics tools, including copilots, AutoML and BI assistants, to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive work
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to use copilots and BI assistants to speed up their own analysis, so AI is their tool.
evidence.testing_framing: Apply appropriate validation and human judgement when using analytical and AI-generated outputs.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Validation refers to judging analytical and AI outputs, not data testing, contracts or quality frameworks, so absent.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Apply appropriate validation and human judgement when using analytical and AI-generated outputs.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Concern about misleading AI outputs and bias appears but stays secondary to delivering insight, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Develop and maintain scalable analytics solutions
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Develop and maintain carry equal weight, and the aim is to replace manual analysis with automated solutions, so mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: Strong data and AI literacy, including the ability to understand analytical and AI models conceptually, evaluate assumptions and outputs, identify limitations or potential biases and apply appropriate business judgement.
